verdicts.human_summary: waitForModuleGraph interval not cleared on bail(), causing memory leak and potential errors accessing a closed server
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 0 identifies the exact same issue: waitForModuleGraph is a local variable in start() that is inaccessible from bail(), so the interval keeps firing indefinitely after bail. Both propose the same fix: hoist the interval handle to module scope and call clearInterval in bail().
